9 pet grooming chains have **4,907 ads in the Meta Ad Library** between them, and **4,288** of those were running when we read it on October 8, 2026. Below is a page of creative from each, what formats carry the category, and how long the ads that work stay up.

Before-and-after coats book the appointment, and grooming chains that grow show the dog, not the lobby.

## Which pet grooming chains run the most ads?

The library count is everything a brand has published on Meta. The active count is what was delivering at the read. The ratio between them is the account’s posture: a large library with a small active share is a brand cycling hard, and one where nearly everything is live is running a small curated set.

Meta Ad Library, read October 8, 2026. Library and active counts are Meta’s own. 9 of these pet grooming chains have enough creative on file for a page of their own.

## What formats do pet grooming ads use?

**carousel leads at 44 percent** of the 318 creatives read here, with video at 37 percent and static at 19. Shop now carries 41 percent of the calls to action.

The median creative here ran **43 days** and the longest was still up at 378. Run length is the closest thing to a public performance signal these libraries publish, because nobody keeps paying to deliver an ad that is not working. How that compares with every other industry is in the [Meta ad creative benchmarks](https://www.sprites.ai/meta-ad-benchmarks).

Each format on its own page: [Pet grooming video ads](https://www.sprites.ai/pet-grooming-video-ads) · [Pet grooming static ads](https://www.sprites.ai/pet-grooming-static-ads) · [Pet grooming carousel ads](https://www.sprites.ai/pet-grooming-carousel-ads)

### The offers pet grooming chains lead with

*   **A price in the ad**: 12 percent of ads · Pet Supplies Plus: “Save $6 on Nutra Complete”
*   **A discount**: 5 percent of ads · Petco: “35% OFF your first order”
*   **A deadline**: 2 percent of ads

0 percent of these ads open with a question, 19 percent put a number in the first line, and 1 percent lead with an emoji.
